blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **ли́чность** — personality. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**личность** — ли́чность: personality; person, individual; identity. Wiktionary: ли́чный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ре́зкость** — harshness. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ли́чность — personality; ре́зкость — harshness; де́ятельность — activity; сло́жность — complexity, complicacy, complication, difficulty.

exercises.q: Tom was surprised by Mary's abruptness.
exercises.why: **Резкость** — ре́зкость: harshness; acuity; abruptness; sharpness (of an image). Wiktionary: ре́зкий + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **де́ятельность** — activity. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

**сложности** — сло́жность: complexity, complicacy, complication, difficulty. Wiktionary: сло́жный + -ость.

exercises.why: **действи́тельность** — reality, actuality. Source: Wiktionary, «-ость» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ость#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**Действительность** — действи́тельность: reality, actuality; validity (of a document). Wiktionary: действи́тельный + -ость.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: действи́тельность — reality, actuality; реши́тельность — resolution, resoluteness, decision; ча́стность — particular; нару́жность — appearance, looks; exterior.
